s.note: the dog ate a whole wheel, Ron isn't even mad
s.how: Score the top of a 500g brie wheel. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey, scatter thyme and 50g walnuts and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until molten. Serve with crackers. Baxter would approve.

s.note: the pride of San Diego, Ron's town
s.how: Marinate 500g skirt steak in juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 1 hour, grill hot 3 minutes a side and chop. Bake 750g frozen fries until crisp, cover with 150g grated Monterey Jack and grill to melt. Top with the steak, 1 mashed avocado and 100g sour cream.

m.note: Ron's town, a very big deal
m.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with lime. Serve in 12 warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, pico de gallo and the crema. Stay classy.

w.n: Milk was a bad choice ice cream
w.note: the hot day Ron drinks a full carton of milk
w.how: Warm 500ml milk and 300ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook to 82C. Chill overnight and churn. Serve in small bowls, never chugged.

d.how: Put one big ice cube in each of four heavy tumblers. Pour 45ml blended Scotch over each and swirl gently. Sip it slowly in a leather chair, surrounded by many leather-bound books, and keep the bottle handy.
